title: Nasal Resonance Change After Endoscopic Endonasal Transsphenoidal Skull Base Surgery: Analysis of Quality of Voice
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine nasal resonance change after endoscopic endonasal transsphenoidal skull base surgery. Furthermore, the quality of voice is assessed, also.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who underwent endoscopic endonasal transsphenoidal skull base surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under 18 year
* Patients cannot following command including loss of conscious
* Patients cannot speak including patient on tracheostomy tube
* Patients who has nasal tumor, nasal polyp, sinusitis
* Patients who has cleft lip cleft palate or submucosal cleft
* Patients who underwent adenotonsillectomy or palatoplasty in same setting with endoscopic pituitary surgery
study_population: Patients who underwent endoscopic endonasal transsphenoidal skull base surgery
